criteria.name: Relevance
criteria.description: The response directly addresses the customer's concern.

criteria.name: Empathy
criteria.description: The response acknowledges the customer's situation and demonstrates understanding.

criteria.name: Professionalism
criteria.description: The response uses polite, clear and professional language.

criteria.name: Helpfulness
criteria.description: The response provides appropriate and actionable next steps.

criteria.name: Policy Compliance
criteria.description: The response does not make unauthorised promises or invent company policies.

criteria.name: Factuality
criteria.description: The response is consistent with the provided product and customer information.
